user_query: I'm organizing a space-themed party and I want to create a playlist with space-related songs. Can you suggest some articles about spaceflight and space exploration? Also, provide me with the stream URLs of the live TV channels that cover space news.

TaskList.description: Search for articles related to spaceflight and space exploration.
Collect and compile the stream URLs of live TV channels that cover space news.
Create a playlist using the space-related songs obtained.
